svg.aria-label: Where I fit. Product Management: find the real problem, write clear requirements, prove value; proof: Third Estate data rebuild with 60% fewer duplicate records. Solution Engineering: proofs of concept, ERP/CRM/CPQ integrations, API contracts; proof: Configit delivery across Salesforce, SAP and Configit CPQ. Solution Consulting: process mapping, approvals and governance, change adoption; proof: FactSet, helped cut client onboarding 40%.
